 Tobey Maguire’s ex-wife finds love again — Meet her husband, billionaire heir Geoffrey Ogunlesi
 Maguire and Jennifer Meyer separated in 2016, finalizing their divorce last year
 © Getty Images for Jennifer Meyer 
 Maria Loreto Senior Writer NOVEMBER 6, 2026 6:24 PM EST NOV 6, 2026, 6:24 PM EST 
 Tobey Maguire' s ex is happy and in love. Jennifer Meyer recently married Geoffrey Ogunlesi. The person marrying them? Maguire himself, who finalized his divorce from Meyer just last year. 
 © Variety via Getty Images Geoffrey Ogunlesi, Jennifer Meyer at the CHANEL and Charles Finch Pre-Oscar Awards Dinner 
 The former couple has a good relationship. Despite the fact that they finalized their divorce recently, they've been separated since 2016. In a podcast appearance in 2022, Meyer revealed that she and Maguire were partners/
 "We did a lot of work to stay on track to stay a family," she said. "But now we talk about our significant others and 'Hey, you got the kids? I'm going for a weekend away.'"
 The pair share two kids: Ruby, 19, and Otis, 17. On Oct. 10th, Maguire himself officiated the wedding between Meyer and Ogunlesi, showing just how far their partnership goes. The ceremony was attended by the couple's children and by many of their celebrity friends, among them, Lauren Sanchez-Bezos and Jeff Bezos, Leonardo DiCaprio and Vittoria Ceretti, and more. 
 © Getty Images for Jennifer Meyer Tobey Maguire and Jennifer Meyer at Jennifer Meyer's 20th anniversary celebration in 2025

 Their relationship is so positive that Meyer and Ogunlesi stayed with Maguire and the children following the California wildfires. 
 “It was the greatest,” said Meyer on The Inside Edit. “Every day I would walk in and I’d be like, ‘I’m so lucky,’ and then I’d come home at night and Tobey and Geoff and his best friend would be watching a movie on the couch. I’d be like ‘How? This is a dream.’”
 © Getty Images for Jennifer Meyer Maguire and Meyer finalized their divorce last year 
 Meet Geoffrey Ogunlesi
 Ogunlesi is the son of a wealthy family, with his father, Adebayo Ogunlesi, having a net worth of $2.6 billion. He's a Nigerian lawyer, investment banker, and founder of Global Infrastructure Partners. 
 He's 34 years old and a graduate of Amherst College. He works in music management, having worked for Warner Music Group before launching his own company, The Ogunlesi Group, which has clients like Alabama Barker and Young Thug.
 Ongulesi and Meyer were first romantically linked in 2023, making their red carpet debut at a Baby2Baby gala. The pair shared news of their engagement the following year. The two share a daughter, whom they welcomed in May of this year.
